name: Entry & Bootstrap
description: Application bootstrapping layer including the HTML shell, React entry point, and global CSS stylesheets that initialize the app.

name: App Shell & Routing
description: Root application component that orchestrates page routing via state, manages modals (login, search), and provides the global layout with navbar, mobile nav, and chat widget.

name: Pages
description: Top-level page components mapped to different views in the application, including home, explorer, login, and program details pages.

name: UI Components
description: Reusable UI components organized by feature domain including navigation, dashboard, programs, events, and home page sections.

name: Data Layer
description: Static data sources including the events seed data module and mockup JSON used throughout the application.

name: Configuration & Tooling
description: Project configuration files for Vite, Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, ESLint, and NPM package manifest defining build tooling and dependencies.
